import "math"

speed = from(bucket: "weather")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather_station" and r._field == "wind_speed_mph")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "speed"})

dir = from(bucket: "weather")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather_station" and r._field == "wind_dir_deg")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "deg"})

join(tables: {speed: speed, dir: dir}, on: ["_time"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      cardinal = if r.deg >= 337.5 or r.deg < 22.5 then "N"
        else if r.deg < 67.5 then "NE"
        else if r.deg < 112.5 then "E"
        else if r.deg < 157.5 then "SE"
        else if r.deg < 202.5 then "S"
        else if r.deg < 247.5 then "SW"
        else if r.deg < 292.5 then "W"
        else "NW"
      return {_time: r._time, label: string(v: int(v: math.round(x: r.speed))) + " mph " + cardinal}
  })

sr = from(bucket: "weather")
  |> range(start: -20m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather_station" and r._field == "solar_radiation_wm2")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> drop(columns: ["host", "_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "_field"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "solar_radiation_wm2"})

alt = from(bucket: "weather")
  |> range(start: -20m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "astro" and r._field == "sun_altitude_deg")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: mean, createEmpty: true)
  |> drop(columns: ["host", "_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "_field"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "sun_altitude_deg"})

join(tables: {sr: sr, alt: alt}, on: ["_time"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      cosZ = math.cos(x: (90.0 - r.sun_altitude_deg) * math.pi / 180.0)
      clearSkyGhi = 1098.0 * cosZ * math.exp(x: -0.059 / cosZ)
      idx = if r.sun_altitude_deg > 3.0 and exists r.solar_radiation_wm2 then r.solar_radiation_wm2 / clearSkyGhi * 100.0 else -1.0
      clamped = if idx > 120.0 then 120.0 else idx
      return {_time: r._time, _value: clamped}
  })
  |> last()

panels.description: Measured solar radiation as a % of the Haurwitz clear-sky model's prediction for the current sun angle. ~80-120%=clear, ~40-80%=partly cloudy, <40%=overcast (can't distinguish cloud from smoke/dust/haze - all reduce this the same way). Daytime only (sun >3 deg elevation).

import "math"

sr = from(bucket: "weather")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "weather_station" and r._field == "solar_radiation_wm2")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> drop(columns: ["host", "_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "_field"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "solar_radiation_wm2"})

alt = from(bucket: "weather")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "astro" and r._field == "sun_altitude_deg")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> drop(columns: ["host", "_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "_field"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "sun_altitude_deg"})

join(tables: {sr: sr, alt: alt}, on: ["_time"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.sun_altitude_deg > 3.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      cosZ = math.cos(x: (90.0 - r.sun_altitude_deg) * math.pi / 180.0)
      clearSkyGhi = 1098.0 * cosZ * math.exp(x: -0.059 / cosZ)
      idx = r.solar_radiation_wm2 / clearSkyGhi * 100.0
      clamped = if idx > 120.0 then 120.0 else idx
      return {_time: r._time, _value: clamped}
  })
  |> yield(name: "clear_sky_index")
